correctness.rationale: There are exactly 28 nonpalindromic binary length-6 reversal orbits. Each admissible word is a path in the 32-vertex length-5 suffix graph consuming each orbit at most once. The recurrence F(v,S)=max({0} union {1+F(new suffix,S+orbit)}) is exhaustive by induction on remaining orbits and proves globally 21 edges is optimal. A literal-word exhaustive implementation independently agrees with the 22 maximizers found by the recurrence; all endpoints and six orbit sizes checked by direct finite enumeration. No unbounded implication is claimed.

originality.rationale: The 1992 original technical report and 2022 full paper explicitly establish optimum length 26 and the latter introduces ideal words, but the inspected relevant sections do not state the count 22, all six symmetry orbits, or necessity of the opposite constant endpoints for EVERY maximizer. The exhaustive classification is logically stronger than exhibiting one ideal optimum. 2024 sources focus on construction/length. Multiple actual published-result and literature searches found no equivalent statement; uncertainty from the uninspected printed 1993 expansion and unindexed enumeration is explicitly retained.
residual_risks: The 1993 published chapter expanding Burns–Mitchell 1992 was not acquired in full; the available full-text technical report was inspected in the directly relevant sections. An unpublished list generated during original exhaustive searches could contain the same 22 words.
An unindexed publication or alternative terminology could disclose the complete six-orbit classification. Search failure is not an absolute proof of novelty.
The 2024 source relevant pages were inspected, not every appendix image; the finite census is nonetheless logically distinct from its stated construction theorems.

value.rationale: The exact number and six equivalence types of maximum-length orientation-distinguishing position sequences are natural missing finite invariants of an established optimum. All-maximizer endpoint rigidity is a stronger structural fact than constructing an ideal example; it specifies which maximizers occur and why their boundary form is unavoidable. Practical motivation is position sensing and exact finite design choice, without unsupported claims of algorithmic or asymptotic improvement.
